characters.name: Halvor
characters.description: Halvor is a young man with a slender build and an unkempt appearance. He has tattered clothes that indicate his former indolence. His hair is shaggy and dark, and his face shows signs of curiosity and determination despite his modest beginnings. Over the course of the story, he becomes more refined, especially when he acquires a royal stature with fine clothes and a radiant ring that signifies his magical quest.

characters.name: Tre-hodet Troll
characters.description: Tre-hodet Troll is a fearsome creature with an imposing height and build. It has three grotesque heads that burst through castle doors, each with menacing expressions and sharp teeth. Its skin is a mottled greenish-grey, and its overall look is intimidating, showcasing the formidable challenges Halvor faces.

characters.name: Yngste Prinsessen
characters.description: Yngste Prinsessen is incredibly beautiful, with an ethereal allure that makes her the most admired among the three sisters. She has flowing, golden hair and delicate features. Her attire resembles that of royalty, adorned with intricate patterns and luxurious materials, reflecting her noble status. Her bond with Halvor is significant, marked by her affection and gratitude for his bravery.

characters.name: Vestenvinden
characters.description: Vestenvinden is depicted as a personified wind spirit, with a form that appears ethereal and transient, emphasizing its elemental nature. It is a guiding force that aids Halvor on his quest. Vestenvinden's presence is dynamic, with swirling motions of air around its form, accentuated by a serene countenance that offers wisdom and direction.
